data.narrative:
Mojo Vision is a Series B-stage chip design company operating in the Semiconductors sector, having raised $345M to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a peer set of 8 private and 3 public comparables in chips and semiconductors, including stage-adjacent companies such as SambaNova Systems ($11.0B, Series A), Rebellions ($2.3B, Series A), d-Matrix ($2.0B, Series A), Positron AI ($1.0B, Series B), and DEEPX ($529M, Series C).

Two methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis uses the $345M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $656M. Peer-median anchoring across the five-company comparable set produces a median valuation of $2.0B, with a range spanning $529M to $11.0B. Public-comp P/S anchoring cannot be applied, as Mojo Vision's revenue is not disclosed, though the median public semiconductor multiple is 18.4x across ALAB, NVDA, and AMD.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $557M (low) to $2.3B (high), with a median of $1.3B. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion within the peer set—driven partly by stage heterogeneity and market timing—and the absence of Mojo Vision's revenue, which would enable public-comp validation. The peer-median method carries greater weight given stage relevance, though the stage-progression figure provides a conservative floor.
